note: Treg vs conventional CD4 split on Foxp3 × CD127. tot_Treg: total regulatory T cells (CD4 lineage) — distinct cluster at the right (Foxp3+) and toward the lower edge (CD127-low). non_Treg: conventional helper T cells (Treg-excluded CD4 pool; parent for downstream memory and Th-polarization steps) — broad cluster at the left (Foxp3 low/negative).
tips: Treg vs conventional CD4 split. tot_Treg: Foxp3+ CD127lo. non_Treg: Foxp3- (any CD127). Category-coverage caveat: Foxp3+ CD127hi events (rare; activated Tconv or recently-induced Treg) do not match either rule and will be unassigned. In-panel co-marker priors: (1) CD25 IS in this panel — a widely used operational Treg definition adds CD25+ (Foxp3+ CD127lo CD25+), which could filter Foxp3+CD127lo CD25- events (often Foxp3-transient Tconv, not stable Treg). (2) Helios is in panel and is applied at Step 10 for lineage-stability stratification. (3) HLA-DR (in panel, unused) has been associated with a highly-suppressive activated Treg subset (Baecher-Allan).
